'''Joal Torviss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Working on board the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]], she provided other Imperials with equipment from her workplace in the supplies section of the station. While working she wore [[Color/Legends|bronze]] and red [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Joal Torviss was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she serves as an Imperial ultimate gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
